title: Regrets: he would get a conservatory education
summary: He would retire only when God says so but would have gone to a conservatory since education is the simplification of life.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: No, if I had start all over again, as a matter of fact, I will retire when God tell me to retire.
Okay, let us say Machito is twenty years old, now would you do anything different?

Just, just a little different. I'd went to a conservatory to know what I am doing, to know what everybody is doing, because I consider education the simplification of life. A good education make you a better person because you understand better. Comprehension is more clear.
In other words, if you had your life to live over you'd make sure you get yourself a college education.
Oh, yes, no question about it. I don't want to miss the punch line of life.
